
 ◇ susynth › ? Help · ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll
 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      PAGES                                                                   █
      Esc 1 … Esc 7          Play, Sets, Recordings, Sounds, Settings,        █
  ▶   Help, Perform                                                           █
  ≡   Esc f  /  Esc b        next / previous page                             │
  ●   Esc                    from any page, back to Play                      │
  ♪   m                      the pages pop-up beside the icons: ↑↓            │
  ⚙   choose, Enter open, m or Esc close                                      │
  ?   In the editor on Play, m types the letter: press Esc m there.           │
  ◈   The number is the page's place in the pop-up. Press Esc, then the       │
      key within 1.5 s, or hold Alt.                                          │
      F1-F7 still open those pages when the terminal sends function keys.     │
      KEYS ON EACH PAGE                                                       │
      Sets                   ↑↓ select · Enter load · a add to the set        │
      list · n new · d delete (asks first)                                    │
      Recordings             ↑↓ select · Enter show the path · d delete       │
      (asks first)                                                            │
      Sounds                 ↑↓ select · ←→ fold a group · Enter preview      │
      or fold · i insert the example                                          │
  ● play   ● 60 bpm · bar 1 · ●○○○   ○ rec off
  ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll   m pages   ^Q quit
